Correct the ts/quote attribution in that row. Either cite setter_scope_discipline or explicitly label this as an unschematized gap rather than implying an existing protocol was violated. Additionally, consider softening the priority-1 coaching_focus framing on the ground-mount disclosure (04:47) — the reactive read (rep correctly stating a known company fact) is at least as well-supported as the escalation-risk read, so this should not be presented as the top coaching priority without more hedging. Optionally add the missed round-robin transparency moment (07:06) as a positive knowledge_gap_handling example, and note the unaddressed sponsorship/promotional-partnership ask (00:12) as a qualification gap, though neither is severe enough alone to block approval.
